mapper.select: select id,device_Code deviceCode,uav_Code uavCode,uav_name uavName,send_time sendTime,send_user_id sendUserId,latitude,longitude,address,tenant_id tenantId,industry_code as industryCode,un_connect_time unConnectTime from `vm_air_contact_alarm_t` where delete_flag = 0 and type = 1 and status = 0 and send_time <= now()

select task_Record_Id taskRecordId,compare_task_record_id as compareTaskRecordId,pt.latitude as latitude,pt.longitude as longitude,tt.access_node as accessNode,lt.device_code,lt.tenant_id as tenantId,lt.industry_code as industryCode,lt.flight_route_id as flightRouteId, pt.algorithm_code as algorithmCode,t.id as id from vm_air_line_compare_task_t t left join vm_air_line_compare_photo_t pt on pt.id = t.compare_id left join vm_air_task_t tt on tt.plan_task_id = t.task_Record_Id left join vm_air_line_t lt on lt.flight_route_id = tt.flight_route_id where compare_Status = 0 and compare_Date <= now() AND compare_Date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR
